text:
Mira: hey @people-ops — quick heads up: i'm scheduled for a minor surgery next month (June 15). surgeon recommends ~2 weeks full rest + 2 weeks limited duties. can i start an ADA accommodation request for temporary remote work + light duties? my manager @Sam_Manager okayed remote work but asked me to loop HR in.

Sam_Manager: thanks for the heads up, Mira. i can cover on-call and shift a couple deliverables. remote looks fine for her role — no blockers from my side. happy to confirm in writing. :thumbsup:

Jane_PeopleOps: hi Mira — sorry to hear and thanks for flagging. please complete the ADA intake form here: https://redwoodhr.example/ada-intake and attach any supportive documentation (doctor's note). once we have the intake we'll schedule a short interactive meeting to discuss reasonable accommodations. aim is ~3 business days after intake.

Mira: done — just submitted the intake and uploaded a doctor's note. filing is under my name. please confirm next steps.

Jane_PeopleOps: received — thanks. @it-support-bot can you confirm VPN/SSO provisioning and any equipment loaners if needed? also note we can offer a one-time ergonomic stipend; we'll include that in the accommodation agreement if helpful.

it-support-bot: Ticket created: IT-3281. Action items:
- Provision VPN + MFA check for Mira
- Confirm SSO and calendar delegated access for Sam_Manager
- Prepare loaner peripherals if requested
ETA: 2 business days. Reply with "loaner" + office location if you want equipment.

HR-Bot: HR case opened: ADA-2025-045. Assigned to Jane_PeopleOps. Confidentiality: details limited to People Ops + Mira's manager unless Mira authorizes wider disclosure.

Taylor_Peer: i can take Mira's recurring product reviews and cover standups for two weeks. Mira, send a quick list of meetings you'd like me to own.

Mira: appreciate that, Taylor — i'll DM the list after standup.

Jane_PeopleOps: quick benefits note — short-term disability is an option for extended leave and can be initiated via benefits@redwood. it's optional for remote accommodations and we'll coordinate based on your recovery. we'll draft an accommodation agreement with effective dates and reasonable duties. expect the draft by 2025-05-03 for review.

Sam_Manager: sounds good. i already blocked recurring all-hands conflicts and adjusted the calendar. no blockers converting Mira to remote for that period.

Mira: thank you everyone. i'm relieved this is moving quickly. let me know if you need any more paperwork or signatures.

Jane_PeopleOps: we'll send the accommodation agreement and next steps in thread + email. if anything changes with the surgery date, update us here. closing loop once signed. :white_check_mark:
